outcome: Incidence of acute postoperative pain after cesarean section
Severity of acute postoperative pain after cesarean section
cohort: 290 parturients who underwent cesarean section at Gandhi Memorial Hospital from December 1, 2019 to February 28, 2020
finding: History of previous cesarean section, preoperative anxiety, transverse incision, and incision length >10 cm were associated with an increased risk of moderate-to-severe acute postoperative pain after cesarean section.
